Estimate Official FIES Food Insecurity Prevalences and Combined Margins of Error

Source: R/estimate_fies.R
estimate_fies.Rd

Computes population prevalence estimates, confidence intervals, coefficients of variation, and total standard errors combining complex-survey Taylor linearization (`se_s`, accounting for stratification and primary sampling units) with Rasch latent measurement error (`se_m`), following the official INEI / FAO methodology.

Usage

estimate_fies(
  data,
  by = NULL,
  indicator = c("both", "mod_sev", "sev"),
  conf_level = 0.95,
  combine_by = FALSE,
  percent = TRUE
)

Arguments

data

A household-level data frame or `fies_tbl` produced by [prepare_fies()].

by

Disaggregation specification: * `NULL` (default): National prevalence by survey year. * `"official"`: Generates in one call National, Area (`Urban`/`Rural`), Natural Region (`Coast`/`Highlands`/`Jungle`), all 24 Departments + Callao, and the official 26-domain regional breakdown (`region_inei`, separating `Lima Metropolitana` and `Lima Region`). * A character vector of one or more column names in `data` (e.g., `c("area", "poverty")` or `"has_child_u5"`).

indicator

Character string indicating which FIES threshold(s) to estimate: `"both"` (default), `"mod_sev"` (Moderate or Severe), or `"sev"` (Severe).

conf_level

Confidence level for margins of error and intervals. Defaults to `0.95`.

combine_by

Logical; when `by` is a vector of 2 or more column names, if `TRUE`, also estimates the Cartesian interaction of those variables (e.g., `area x poverty`). Ignored when `by` is `NULL` or `"official"`.

percent

Logical; if `TRUE` (default), scales `estimate`, `lower`, `upper`, `moe`, `se_total`, `se_s`, `se_m`, and `cv` to percentages (`0`–`100`). Set to `FALSE` for proportions (`0`–`1`).

Value

A [tibble::tibble()] with columns `year`, `group`, `category`, `indicator`, `estimate`, `lower`, `upper`, `moe`, `se_total`, `se_s`, `se_m`, `cv`, and `n_unweighted`.

Examples

df_demo <- prepare_fies(sample_data = fies_sample, quiet = TRUE)
estimate_fies(df_demo, by = c("area", "poverty"))
